verdict.rationale: Bruno ships a built-in, bring-your-own-key AI with three relevant pieces: ghost-text suggestions in the script editors, an AI chat sidebar for questions from anywhere in the workspace, and generation of scripts, tests, docs and apps that uses the open request or collection as context. That covers in-product AI suggestions grounded in the user's API data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI analysis or insights over response data and run results, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
